title: Embedding ground-truth curation + nightly evaluation pipeline
creator: Priya Nair
description: Build a reproducible ground-truth curation flow and a nightly offline evaluation harness for embeddings and reranking endpoints. Goal: provide stable quality baselines (golden sets), automated metric computation and drift detection, and actionable alerts for regressions or distributional shifts across tenants and input slices.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical golden set (per domain) stored in versioned S3 prefixes with provenance metadata and review history
Nightly pipeline runs compute embedding quality metrics (R@1,R@5,MRR,cosine-distance-quantiles) for each golden set and publishes time-series to Datadog and metrics DB
Drift detectors evaluate population-level embedding shifts (mean cosine, covariance trace) and trigger Slack + PagerDuty alerts when thresholds are exceeded
Pipeline runtime for full corpora <= 2 hours on scheduled runners; incremental mode for daily delta runs <= 30 minutes
Automated ticket/PR generation when regression exceeds configurable severity leading to triage workflow
Playbook for manual curation and rollback of golden sets documented and linked in the ticket
tasks: Design canonical golden-set schema and required provenance fields (source, owner, creation_method, review_signoff)
Implement ingestion tooling: human curation UI (lightweight) + bulk importer for labelled pairs and relevance judgments
Author Airflow DAG for nightly evaluation with parallelized slice jobs and incremental mode
Metric calculators: R@k, MRR, cosine-distance quantiles, embedding-length distributions, cluster entropy
Implement drift rules with both absolute and percentile triggers; persist raw distributions for forensic analysis
Integrate outputs with Datadog, metrics warehouse (analytics-db), and create Grafana dashboard with per-domain baselines
Add latency profiling to harness: sample end-to-end embedding latency under folded load and record p50/p95/p99
Wire alerting into triage process: create GitHub issue template and automatically tag responsible owners
Write runbook and handoff doc for platform and MLEs; schedule initial review with PM/Design stakeholders
comments: 2026-02-11 Priya N: Initial proposal reviewed with embeddings team, agreed on per-domain goldens instead of single global set to reduce noise.
2026-02-24 Carlos M: Spike completed for R@k calculators, found performance bottleneck in naive pairwise scoring for large corpora; will move scorer to Cython and batch vector ops.
2026-03-03 Rebecca L (PM): Add tenant-stratified sampling — product asked for alerting only when tenant-specific drift exceeds medium impact threshold.
2026-03-07 Design review: UX for curation UI accepted; PD suggested 'review_signoff' with two reviewers for high-sensitivity domains.
2026-03-09 Infra note: Nightly runners provisioned in us-west-2; will test eu-west-1 for non-blocking regional baselines next sprint.
2026-03-12 Carlos M: Nightly DAG MVP pushed to feature branch; metrics emitted to staging Datadog namespace for validation.
risks: Label quality: noisy or inconsistent labels may produce false positives in drift alerts
Cost: full-corpus nightly runs could increase compute spend if not gated or sampled
Latency measurement: synthetic sampling may not capture tail behavior under real production concurrency
rollout_plan: Week 1: Deploy DAG to staging, validate metrics with sample goldens and telemetry
Week 2: Run parallel nightly (staging vs prod) for 5 days, compare outputs and tune thresholds
Week 3: Enable alerting for low-severity in a Slack channel, gather feedback; enable PagerDuty for high-severity only after 2 stable weeks
Post-rollout: Quarterly review of golden-set coverage and automatic sampling policies
